data.situation:
By two on Saturday, 15 May, the garden concert had finished, but the carnival outside the centre was still lively. Maya followed Jo through the courtyard to the little square. A marching band was passing the gate, its drummer stepping around a child’s dropped flag. Maya raised her camera too late. The flag was blurred in the photograph, but the image captured something of the cheerful atmosphere. She had taken up photography that winter and usually preferred quiet streets. Jo asked whether the picture could go on next month’s notice. Maya agreed to discuss it later. At a table by the gate, a copyright note on the back of another photograph named its owner; it was not a promise that every picture on the table could be copied. Jo: The blurred flag makes the photograph feel more alive.
Maya: Perhaps. I meant to get the whole band.
Jo: May I contact you about using it in the notice?
Maya: Yes. Send me the proposed notice first.
Jo: I will. We can also check whether anyone shown in it needs to be asked.

readingBlocks.zh: 5月15日星期六，到了下午两点，花园音乐会已经结束，中心外的节庆活动仍很热闹。玛雅跟着乔穿过院子，来到小广场。一支行进乐队正经过大门，鼓手绕开了孩子掉在地上的旗子。玛雅举起相机时已经晚了，照片里的旗子有些模糊，却仍捕捉到了现场欢快的气氛。她从那年冬天开始学摄影，平时更喜欢拍安静的街道。乔问，这张照片能否放进下个月的告示。玛雅答应稍后商量。大门旁的桌上，另一张照片背面的版权说明写着权利人的名字，这并不意味着桌上每张照片都可以随意复制。

readingBlocks.en:
Jo: The blurred flag makes the photograph feel more alive.
Maya: Perhaps. I meant to get the whole band.
Jo: May I contact you about using it in the notice?
Maya: Yes. Send me the proposed notice first.
Jo: I will. We can also check whether anyone shown in it needs to be asked.
readingBlocks.zh:
乔：模糊的旗子反而让照片更有现场感。
玛雅：也许吧。我本来想拍下整支乐队。
乔：我可以联系你，商量把照片用在告示里吗？
玛雅：可以。先把告示的拟稿发给我。
乔：好。我们也可以核对照片里的人是否需要征询意见。

glossary.zh: 公众庆祝和娱乐的节庆活动
glossary.note: carnival在本课指有音乐等公众活动的节庆；并不把普通小型会议也称carnival。
glossary.example: The carnival outside the centre was still lively.
glossary.exampleZh: 中心外的节庆活动仍很热闹。

externalEvidence.definition: a festival marked by merrymaking and processions

glossary.zh: 一边行进一边演奏的乐队
glossary.note: marching band 指一边行进一边演奏的乐队。
glossary.example: A marching band was passing the gate.
glossary.exampleZh: 一支行进乐队正经过大门。

externalEvidence.definition: a band that marches (as in a parade) and plays music at the same time

glossary.zh: 地点或活动给人的整体气氛
glossary.note: a cheerful atmosphere是现场欢快的气氛；本例不教大气层义。
glossary.example: The image captured something of the cheerful atmosphere.
glossary.exampleZh: 这张照片捕捉到了现场欢快的气氛。

externalEvidence.definition: a particular environment or surrounding influence

glossary.note: photography一般不可数；take up photography说明开始从事摄影，不指一张照片。
glossary.example: Maya had taken up photography that winter.
glossary.exampleZh: 玛雅从那年冬天开始学摄影。

externalEvidence.label: Oxford Learner’s Dictionaries
externalEvidence.reviewFinding: noun [uncountable], taking photographs/filming; digital photography usage

glossary.zh: 作品复制和使用相关的版权
glossary.note: copyright note指标明作品相关权利人的说明。版权与照片里人物的同意不是同一问题，故事不推定许可范围。
glossary.example: A copyright note on the back of another photograph named its owner.
glossary.exampleZh: 另一张照片背面的版权说明写着权利人的名字。

glossary.zh: 照片呈现或捕捉某个特点、瞬间
glossary.note: capture 在本句是及物动词，表示照片呈现活动气氛。
glossary.example: The image captured something of the cheerful atmosphere.
glossary.exampleZh: 这张照片捕捉到了现场欢快的气氛。

externalEvidence.definition: succeed in representing or expressing something intangible
